levels.title: PHP 1 · Clean Syntax & Formatting Basics
levels.concept_capsule: PHP 8.3 and PSR-12 require declare(strict_types=1); after <?php, explicit parameter and return types, opening function braces on a new line, and input trimming.
levels.reference_solution:
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

/**
 * Build a sanitized greeting message.
 */
function greet(string $name): string
{
    $clean = trim($name);
    return $clean === "" ? "Hello!" : "Hello, {$clean}!";
}

formatting_mechanics.documentation_standard: PHPDoc /** ... */ comment block above the function.

analogous_example.title: PHP 8.3 SKU formatter with strict_types and PSR-12 braces
analogous_example.code:
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

/**
 * Format a normalized SKU label.
 */
function formatSku(string $code): string
{
    $clean = trim($code);
    return $clean === "" ? "N/A" : "SKU-{$clean}";
}
analogous_example.why_it_works: Enables strict_types=1, types parameter and return, puts { on a new line, and sanitizes via trim().

levels.title: PHP 2 · Edge Cases & Documentation
levels.concept_capsule: In PHP 8.3 domain states belong in Backed Enums (enum OrderStatus: string) paired with immutable constructor property promotion (public readonly) formatted to PSR-12.
levels.reference_solution:
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

enum OrderStatus: string
{
    case Pending = "pending";
    case Paid = "paid";
}

/**
 * Typed order entity following PSR-12.
 */
final class Order
{
    public function __construct(
        public readonly OrderStatus $status = OrderStatus::Pending,
    ) {
    }
}

analogous_example.title: Invoice entity with Backed Enum and readonly promotion in PHP 8.3
analogous_example.code:
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

enum InvoiceState: string
{
    case Draft = "draft";
    case Issued = "issued";
}

/**
 * Immutable invoice header following PSR-12.
 */
final class Invoice
{
    public function __construct(
        public readonly InvoiceState $state = InvoiceState::Draft,
    ) {
    }
}
analogous_example.why_it_works: Declares enum InvoiceState: string and promotes public readonly $state in a PSR-12 class.
